messages:
eve (eng-ml): Brain-dump: new onboarding flow centered on a fast 'sanity' gate + a shadow-routing phase. Sanity = tokenizer/fingerprint + tiny golden run (<30s). Shadow = mirror 1% traffic for 1-2h to observe real-world latency/quality before any routing. Add admission-handshake v4 with 'rollback_leash' for immediate revoke.

noah (eng-platform): Love the leash idea. We should formalize the admission response: {ready, stage, run_id, rollback_leash, provenance_manifest_uri}. Also require run_id be immutable and surfaced in Console links.

zoe (eng-sre): Operational constraints: shadow must be strictly read-only and rate-limited; no side-effects. Add auto-cut rules: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 1.8x baseline -> abort shadow. Also enforce per-tenant shadow concurrency cap.

marta (product): Customers expect visibility. Console should show: "sanity passed" timestamp, shadow metrics snapshot, estimated ETA for full deep-eval, and a human-review flag if quality regressed.

leo (qa): QA asks: include reproducible seeds + provenance manifest with sha256 checks. Sanity must attach the minimal seedset and a reproduce.sh snippet in the run artifact. For regressions, triage tickets should auto-include repro steps and diffs.

eve (eng-ml): technical detail: sanity uses deterministic short prompts + checksum of tokenization + first-token logits. KV-safety check: run a 3-iteration warmup that validates cache hit stability; mismatch marks runtime as 'kv_unstable' and we fall back to the conservative runtime.

noah (eng-platform): We'll add API flags: "shadow_percent", "shadow_duration_mins", "sanity_seedset_uri" and emit metrics: sanity_pass, shadow_p50, shadow_p95, shadow_error_rate, kv_mismatch_count. Console to include manual abort and rollback_leash redemption.

infra-bot: queued: onboard/sanity-shadow/3322114455 (sanity + kv-warmup)

zoe (eng-sre): Alerts: sanity_fail -> notify eng-ml channel; shadow_abort -> create incident if customer-facing routes were affected. Track run queue depth and total active shadows.

eve (eng-ml): I'll draft an RFC with admission v4 schema, state machine (sanity -> shadow -> microbench -> deep-eval), metric names, and runbook for leash redemption. Owners: eve (design), noah (api/console), leo (qa), zoe (SRE). Will post RFC later today.

marta (product): Nice. Please also list expected latencies for each stage and default shadow percent in the RFC.
